name: --all
purpose: spectator-log.py: every displayed frame of the spectator's log is printed, not only the frames around a change of choice.

name: --altered
purpose: Gate judge (desync): the step before which the difference was made in game 2 (default 1500); the relay must find it within 60 frames of that step.

name: --builds
purpose: Gate judge (mixed): how many different builds the games of a mixed race must have run between them (default 2; 1: a race of one build, as a base line).

name: --control
purpose: Gate judge (playbacks): the row is the control, whose one playback must FAIL (a recording altered on purpose).

name: --copies
purpose: Gate judge (playbacks): RUN ..., the playbacks that must have left a pacing log with screen copies, one size a destination.

name: --detail
purpose: map-report.py: also the functions inside every host place, the kinds of generated body and each guest place's host places.

name: --end
purpose: Gate judge (game): how the game must have ended: results, desync, stop or any (the default).

name: --exe-map
purpose: map-report.py: FILE, the runner's link map (it belongs to one runner build; default <work>/scratch/map/tools/moderngekko-run.map).

name: --expect
purpose: gate-judge.py playbacks: how many playbacks the row's log must hold.

name: --expect-test
purpose: freeze-report.py: judges the run of freeze-run.sh (two freezes, the close from outside, the summary's words); its last line is PASS or FAIL.

name: --from
purpose: map-pace.py and map-report.py: the scene's first race frame (default 600).

name: --functions
purpose: map-report.py: FILE, the module's generated.h: the guest functions' starts when no module map is given.

name: --gaps
purpose: map-pace.py: how many picture gaps over 20 ms are listed (default 12).

name: --harness
purpose: launch-file.py: SCENE, the launch file of a harness scene of the manifest (its start and its settings), in place of a named file of port/configs.

name: --launchers
purpose: Gate judge (quickplay): how many launchers the run started (default 2).

name: --limit
purpose: Gate judge (playback): the seconds the playback was given (replay-check.sh's MAXS); one that has no summary line is then "did not finish".

name: --log
purpose: Gate judge: FILE, the output of the scripts that made the run (a row's log of gates.sh).

name: --manifest
purpose: launch-file.py: FILE, the manifest --harness reads its scene from (default recomp/manifest.toml).

name: --map
purpose: freeze-report.py: PROGRAM=FILE, a linker's map: the call stacks' places are printed with the function each is in.

name: --mode
purpose: map-pace.py and map-report.py: the game's mode whose fields are the scene (default 2, a race).

name: --module-map
purpose: map-report.py: FILE, the module's link map (a relink with /MAP); without it generated code is not split by function or kind of body.

name: --must
purpose: Gate judge (game): the files the run's script always writes (probe, pace); the absence of one is then a failure, not a check that was not made.

name: --only
purpose: Stat packs' report: one part of the proving run alone is judged (plain, plain2, old, pack, two, server, real, refused), as stat-pack-run.sh ONLY=PART ran it.

name: --others
purpose: map-report.py: also every other thread's samples by function.

name: --playbacks
purpose: Gate judge (pair): how many playbacks' result lines the row's log must hold (default 0: none looked for).

name: --race-before
purpose: run-summary.py: FIELD, the time per field is taken over the race's fields before this field only (a run that asks for a picture at FIELD measures the game's pace up to there).

name: --races
purpose: Gate judge (quickplay): how many races each launcher ran (default 2).

name: --same-length
purpose: replay-compare.py: recordings of unequal lengths fail too. Only its own test passes it: the gates leave the lengths to gate-judge.py.

name: --set
purpose: launch-file.py: KEY=JSON, one more key of the launch file by its dotted name (debug.lateSteps=2); replay-check.sh passes its SET= so.

name: --short
purpose: Gate judge (pair): the game (1 or 2) whose own seat the host's rule ended the race for: the logs must name one end step, and that seat must have no finish and not be out in both recordings.

name: --symbols
purpose: map-report.py: FILE, the bundle's symbols.json: the image's routines by name.

name: --tags
purpose: map-report.py: FILE, the executable's functions tagged by the hardware they touch (drawing is told from sound by it).

name: --to
purpose: map-pace.py and map-report.py: the scene's last race frame (default: the run's last).

name: --top
purpose: map-report.py: rows per table (default 40).

name: --undo-check
purpose: Gate judge (playbacks): RUN ..., the playbacks that must have played with debug.undoLog "both" and logged the undo log's guard on and the same log as every page compared at every step.

name: --video
purpose: map-report.py: also the video thread's tables.

name: --window
purpose: map-report.py: S0,S1: the scene is the fields that end between S0 and S1 seconds after the run's first field, whatever the mode.

name: DOLRECOMP_CLOSED_DEBUG
purpose: Prints every closed call edge found while the closed set is computed.

name: DOLRECOMP_CLOSED_ROOTS
purpose: Addresses, or all: the listed functions and what they reach get a second, closed body.

name: DOLRECOMP_INDIRECT_CALL_EXITS
purpose: Hex call sites that keep leaving generated code, for instrumentation that watches dispatches.

name: DOLRECOMP_LLVM_CACHE
purpose: The recompiler's LLVM cache folder, or off: the harness's build command sets it (recomp-kit's; the gates never build).

name: DOLRECOMP_LLVM_DUMP_IR
purpose: The recompiler writes its LLVM IR: the harness's emit command sets it (recomp-kit's; the gates never build).

name: DOLRECOMP_LLVM_ONLY
purpose: Addresses: emits only the chunks that hold them, for inspecting generated code; not a linkable module.

name: DOLRECOMP_PSQ_GQR
purpose: index:hex value pairs: the value the title keeps in a GQR; quantized loads and stores are emitted for it.

name: PORT_WORK
purpose: The port's work folder (default: the folder port/setup/work-folder.env names; port/setup/setup.sh makes one): every script of port/build, port/gates and port/setup works in it.

name: RECOMP_AGENT
purpose: the harness reads it: the name a run takes the PC under (its request file's name; two runs at once need two names). replay-check.sh sets it, one for each playback of a set; here a stand-in harness of its tests reads it.

name: RECOMP_KIT
purpose: A recomp-kit checkout whose tools/harness is used in place of this repository's copy, port/gates/vendor/harness (the default; port/setup/lib.sh HARNESS_DIR): the harness starts every test game, and run-summary.py uses its comparison of two runs.

name: RECOMP_MACHINE
purpose: the harness reads it: the machine file of the run (which runner, which folders). The gate scripts set it; here a stand-in harness of the gates' tests reads it.

name: RECOMP_MANIFEST
purpose: The harness reads it: the game's manifest (recomp/manifest.toml, or replay-check.sh's with its ad hoc scene). The gate scripts set it.

name: RECOMP_TIMING_AGENT
purpose: The harness reads it: 1 in the shell of the one agent whose timing batch may start over a request that has waited too long.

name: SDL_*
purpose: SDL's own variables, read by the SDL library inside the emulator, never by our code. Every script that starts a test game sets SDL_JOYSTICK_HIDAPI_GAMECUBE=0, or the game takes the owner's GameCube controller adapter; RUN_ENV hands others on.
